This should feel like the real reference with subtle realistic 3D architecture and lighting.

Bottom15-18% is a softly blended separate ground-view city/landscape strip, landmark strongest at right, never planted on airport grounds. Do not cover key terminals with footer.
DUPLICATE CHECK: EXACTLY ONE instance of each distinctive landmark/complex total. Input2 contains BAD mirrored clones: do not copy them. No second partial duplicate hiding at an image edge, no matching twin pavilions/towers/hotels. Natural varied scenery.
REMOVE screenshot UI, search bar, logos, watermark, compass, map buttons. No text/cards/titles or typography anywhere. Do not copy any watermark/signage in optional landmark photo.
